title: Christian Wolf — MIT 14.05 Intermediate Macroeconomics, Lecture 19: Sticky Prices (Fall 2025)
use: Exact nominal/real gross-return timing and a primary university route from price-setting/adjustment costs through marginal costs to inflation; scope comparison with the original preset/reset teaching model.
verification: Opened official course resource to verify instructor and term, then actual43-page PDF. Inspected PDF page8 (printed slide5) for gross real return and the state-dependent expectation/Euler expression; PDF pages24–35 (printed slides17–26) for the pricing problem, markup, adjustment-cost specification and inflation–activity derivation; PDF page37 (slide28) for nominal-rigidity scope. The chapter does not reproduce the full NK model, empirical price-frequency claims, infinite-horizon equilibrium or the source's special adjustment-cost experiment. Its quadratic price-target loss, geometric index and preset fraction are expressly original maintained assumptions.

title: Milton Friedman — The Role of Monetary Policy (American Economic Review, March 1968)
use: Anticipated versus realized nominal changes, temporary adjustment and the critique of a permanent exploitable inflation–unemployment trade-off.
verification: Read the actual original-paper PDF hosted by Duke, employment discussion printed pp.8–11 (PDF pages11–14), including nominal versus real wage reasoning, changing expectations and acceleration argument. No historical country inflation figures, transition-duration estimate, claim about today's monetary regime or recommendation of the author's policy rule is imported. The chapter's adaptive coefficient, shock comparisons, stability proof and model-consistent finite expectations calculations are original.
